A large '''asteroid belt''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Algunnis]] [[Binary star system/Legends|binary star]] in the [[Algunnis system/Legends|Algunnis system]].

==Description==
Located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Algunnis system/Legends|Algunnis system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], a large [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] was the sole [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="GK" />

==History==
The [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field in the Algunnis system was theorized by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to have been formed during the formation of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], created from [[Planet/Legends|planets]] ensnared by [[Algunnis]] as it traveled past them. The planets were then torn apart by the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] stresses to form a massive asteroid field. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the belt was home to several [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] but no settlers.<ref name="GK" />
